source.title: Controllare il worker Symphony che possiede il turno attivo
source.objective: C3 deve esporre osservazione, stop e steer del worker Symphony tramite il backend/app-server che possiede il turno attivo. I follow-up accodati non correggono il turno corrente e un app-server separato non può steerarlo; il 30 settembre 2026 ciò ha impedito di interrompere subito un worker C3 che ripeteva gate roadmap_start/executor_started.

work_item_evidence.label: issue:61693399ea114824b404d0afc483f42b
work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "C2 active Codex supervision gap: each c2_worker owns a private stdio `codex app-server`. `codex queue` can enqueue a follow-up but does not steer the current active turn, while `turn/steer` issued through a separate app-server is rejected because it does not own that active turn. This prevented the supervisor from immediately correcting a live C3 worker looping on redundant roadmap_start/executor_started gates. C3 cross-surface backend control should expose native observe/stop/steer against the owning Symphony/app-server worker instead of private per-worker stdio sessions.", "executor": null, "executor_ref": null, "issue_id": "issue:61693399ea114824b404d0afc483f42b", "observed_at_ms": 1790763520005, "origin_run_id": null, "origin_work_item_id": null, "repo": null}

work_item_evidence.label: issue:527c16b453214b55a040922b16c095c2
work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "Codex/C2 supervision hazard observed on C3 thread 01a0f1c8-8dfd-7490-b294-bf45e740598a: opening a second `codex app-server` and issuing `thread/read` against a thread whose turn is actively owned by another private app-server correlates with that active turn becoming `interrupted`. The pattern repeated across multiple recovery turns, so 'read-only' cross-app-server inspection is not safe as a liveness probe for active private-worker threads. C2/C3 supervision must observe through the owning backend/process or durable rollout/status signals, and avoid loading/reading active threads from a competing app-server unless ownership semantics guarantee non-interference.", "executor": null, "executor_ref": null, "issue_id": "issue:527c16b453214b55a040922b16c095c2", "observed_at_ms": 1790764165688, "origin_run_id": null, "origin_work_item_id": null, "repo": null}

work_item_evidence.label: issue:a356e4bdded24c7587a9700ce7a3fec5
work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "C3/Symphony execution boundary bug: a Symphony-dispatched pilot issue cloned gernalix/codex-roadmap and inherited its AGENTS/C2 contract, so the child agent attempted c2_executor_start/roadmap lifecycle again and blocked on gh_failed before any task edit. Once a C2 coding item has been published to Symphony, that handoff is already the managed executor boundary; the Symphony child must not re-enter C2 launch/executor_started/roadmap_start. Encode an explicit managed-Symphony execution context that repo instructions can recognize, or use an equivalent higher-precedence execution policy, without weakening ordinary C2 manual-start fencing. GH-7 reproduced the bug; its workspace remained clean.", "executor": null, "executor_ref": null, "issue_id": "issue:a356e4bdded24c7587a9700ce7a3fec5", "observed_at_ms": 1790765542524, "origin_run_id": null, "origin_work_item_id": null, "repo": null}
